description:
Ingest multi-modal situation snapshot, compute expected utilities against active weights, and output prioritized action recommendations (actions: snapshot, quick). Use evaluate_situation instead of assess_risk when ranking candidate actions across multi-attribute utility dimensions rather than calculating isolated threat probabilities.

Returns ranked candidate actions, expected utility scores, and top recommendation.

action.description: Snapshot evaluation mode or quick text context: snapshot, quick

candidate_actions.description: Candidate actions to score and rank

lookahead_depth.description: Bounded heuristic lookahead plies (e.g. 2-3 plies, discount gamma=0.85)

quick_context.description: Text summary of current situation for quick evaluation

snapshot.description: Normalized SituationSnapshot with world, vision, state, and vitals

utility_profile.description: Named utility profile to score against (defaults to active)

name: evaluate_situation
